name: YHA Port Eynon
accommodation: Private rooms including en-suite doubles; exclusive hire of the whole building
parking: Shared area on a slip road for up to 8 cars
beachAccess: Beachfront, on the seafront at Port Eynon
confirmedFeatures: Self-catering kitchen, dining room, lounge, library, drying room, outdoor seating, free Wi-Fi in shared areas
overview: YHA Port Eynon is a hostel on the seafront at Port Eynon, right next to the beach. It has private rooms, some en-suite, plus a self-catering kitchen, a lounge and a drying room, and groups can hire the whole building.
surfTripFit: The beach is right outside and there is a drying room for wetsuits, and the self-catering kitchen keeps costs down.
